findings.summary: On the Thistlewood-Manip suite with shaped rewards, Heronsgate achieved a higher average success rate (64.3% ± 1.9%) than Pallister (61.8% ± 2.6%), a statistically significant difference (paired t-test, t=5.06, df=7, p=0.0015, 95% CI [1.33, 3.67] percentage points).
findings.scope: Thistlewood-Manip (shaped rewards), average success rate, 8 seeds
findings.caveats: Only this suite and reward setting; not generalizable beyond.

findings.summary: On Thistlewood-Manip-Sparse (binary success reward), Heronsgate's average success rate (38.2% ± 3.3%) was not significantly different from Pallister's (37.5% ± 4.0%); the paired t-test was non-significant (t=0.76, df=7, p=0.47, 95% CI [-1.47, 2.87] percentage points).
findings.caveats: Non-significance does not imply equivalence; only this sparse-reward setting.

findings.summary: Per-task results on Thistlewood-Manip (shaped rewards) show Heronsgate outperformed Pallister on four of six tasks (drawer-open: 82.1 vs 79.8; block-stack: 47.9 vs 43.5; door-unlock: 71.3 vs 66.9; lid-twist: 70.5 vs 64.0), while Pallister was higher on peg-insert (60.2 vs 58.4) and cable-route (56.4 vs 55.6).
findings.scope: Thistlewood-Manip (shaped rewards), per-task success rate, 8 seeds
findings.caveats: No statistical tests reported for per-task comparisons; differences are descriptive.

findings.summary: Heronsgate's performance on Thistlewood-Manip (shaped rewards) is sensitive to the conservatism weight α: average success rate peaks at α=1.0 (64.3%) and declines at α=0.5 (61.0%), α=2.0 (63.7%), and α=5.0 (57.9%).
findings.scope: Thistlewood-Manip (shaped rewards), average success rate, 8 seeds, α values 0.5–5.0
findings.caveats: No statistical tests reported for these comparisons; only mean values.

sentences.text: On the Thistlewood-Manip suite with shaped rewards, Heronsgate achieved a significantly higher average success rate (64.3% ± 1.9%) than Pallister (61.8% ± 2.6%; paired t-test, t=5.06, df=7, p=0.0015, 95% CI [1.33, 3.67] percentage points).

Per-task results on the same suite show Heronsgate outperformed Pallister on four of six tasks (drawer-open: 82.1 vs 79.8; block-stack: 47.9 vs 43.5; door-unlock: 71.3 vs 66.9; lid-twist: 70.5 vs 64.0), while Pallister was higher on peg-insert (60.2 vs 58.4) and cable-route (56.4 vs 55.6).

On Thistlewood-Manip-Sparse (binary success reward), Heronsgate's average success rate (38.2% ± 3.3%) was not significantly different from Pallister's (37.5% ± 4.0%; paired t-test, t=0.76, df=7, p=0.47, 95% CI [-1.47, 2.87] percentage points).

Heronsgate's performance on Thistlewood-Manip (shaped rewards) was sensitive to the conservatism weight α, with average success rate peaking at α=1.0 (64.3%) and declining at α=0.5 (61.0%), α=2.0 (63.7%), and α=5.0 (57.9%).
